angle: Expert, integrity-driven guidance to easily find fair-valued HDBs with no COV in a shifting market.
body_text:
DON’T buy a resale HDB until you watch this video.

Because if you're searching for a resale HDB like THIS—
you're making it 10 times harder than it needs to be.

You want a home in a good location.
You don’t want to overpay.
And the last thing you want is… Surprise COV.

So what usually happens?

You’re up scrolling PropertyGuru late at night… 
Saving units that look promising,
Messaging multiple agents and
Viewing homes one by one, on different days, at different times...

And after weeks of all that?

Prices change.
Units go off the market.
And you're left with decision fatigue and confusion.

Here's what most people miss:

The best-priced units with NO COV?
They don't stay on the market long.

They go to buyers who move fast, with clarity and direction.

So here's the alternative.

We pick out 3-5 suitable Resale HDB from our shortlist of well-priced HDBs, based on your budget, preferred location, and timeline requirements, and arrange to view ALL of them in JUST ONE day.

Whether it’s a 3-room, 4-room, 5-room or bigger, I’ll personally guide you through each option and flag out the sellers who are practical, committed, and open to discussion, so you stop spending time on homes that were NEVER meant to transact.

That means more clarity, less stress, and more importantly, a smarter decision.

Today, if you’re looking for a Resale HDB that’s priced right with minimal or no COV, it’s simple.
CLICK BELOW and we’ll send you more information.

ALSO, don’t forget to share the areas you’re considering, whether it’s Punggol, Sengkang, Yishun, or Jurong, so we can save you more time, and get started ASAP.

headline: Your Home Search Made Easy!
transcript_text: I'll quit real estate by June this year if I can't help 10 families buy a HDB at fair value. Hi, I'm Isaac. Here's why this means everything to me. For over 7 years, I slogged out in a toxic finance job that crushed my soul. Zero transparency and the entire culture shouted profit over people. In 2022, I stepped out from all that money and honestly, comfort to prove that business with integrity is actually way better. So here's what buying at fair value means. After COVID happened, the HDB market went crazy. In just 5 years, it went up by 54%. But since then, the market has shifted. Listings are sitting longer. Sellers are quietly slashing prices. Some are even scrambling to compete. And there comes the problem. Many buyers still don't realize this. They are walking into negotiations thinking it's still a hot market, paying the high asking prices afraid someone else will snatch it up not knowing that they have the leverage And some agents they won tell you because a quick sale at any price is easier than fighting for you So if I can make it here doing things the right way then maybe integrity doesn belong in business at all. But here's what gives me confidence. For the last three years, I've been learning from Yuna, one of Singapore's top agents. She showed me that when you actually dig deeper, when you fight for your clients instead of chasing easy commissions, you will definitely find opportunities others miss. In fact, it's only my 11 months in and I've already helped more than 30 families get no COV deals and even won Property Guru's top rookie agent. So here's my plan. I'm going to document this entire journey because I'm not just trying to hit a number. I'm trying to prove that you don't have to compromise your values to succeed in business. If you're a first-time buyer or PR who wants to buy smart in this cooling market, let's make this happen together. WhatsApp me at 8811 9441 and let's see if I can hit this goal or if I'll be looking for another career in June.
